---
title: "Templates and Generated Assets"
doc-type: reference
---

Templates are the primary product surface. Canonical files under `src/repo_familiar/templates/` combine through `src/repo_familiar/asset_plan.py`; generator plan output is the exact inventory for one selection.

## Registered Templates

| Template | Use | Composition |
|---|---|---|
| `basic` | Generic agentic repository or conservative existing-repository fallback | Instructions, selected profiles and skills, Divio Quarto scaffold, plan, and Bootstrap Metadata. |
| `python-reproducible` | Default new Python repository | `basic` plus uv packaging, lockfile, guardrails, deterministic data exemplar, tests, CI, provenance, and executable docs. |
| `static-quarto-application` | Opt-in interactive analytical product | `python-reproducible` plus a static Quarto client, FastAPI/Pydantic request boundary, Structlog events, API tests, and browser flow. |

New generation defaults to `python-reproducible`. Existing-repository commands use `basic` when no explicit or recorded template exists; application and Python scaffold assets are not silently applied to existing work.

## Asset Categories

Generated assets can include instructions, documentation, project plans, profile/configuration files, vendored skills, dependency manifests and locks, source code, tests, and data fixtures. Bootstrap Metadata records each generated path, kind, canonical source, and checksum when applicable.

Do not maintain a static full file list in prose. Inspect a concrete selection with:

```bash
uv run python -m repo_familiar generate \
  --name "Inspection" \
  --description "Inspect generated assets." \
  --output /tmp/repo-familiar-inspection \
  --template python-reproducible \
  --dry-run
```

## Deterministic Example Snapshots

Examples under `examples/` are generated snapshots and regression fixtures, not hand-authored Downstream Repositories. Their generation fixes source identity and timestamps where necessary so tests can regenerate and compare exact content.

The generic example is regenerated with:

```bash
uv run python -m repo_familiar generate \
  --name "Basic Agentic Project" \
  --description "Example downstream repository generated by repo-familiar." \
  --output examples/basic-agentic-project \
  --template basic \
  --agent-harness opencode \
  --agent-harness paseo \
  --agent-harness hermes \
  --model-profile default-coding \
  --model-profile budget-review \
  --tool-profile cq \
  --memory-profile memory-local \
  --secrets-profile dotenv-local \
  --secrets-profile kvenv-azure-keyvault \
  --skill grill-with-docs \
  --reference-type git \
  --reference-url "https://example.invalid/repo-familiar.git" \
  --reference-ref example-snapshot \
  --generated-at "2026-05-10T00:00:00Z" \
  --force
```

Update canonical templates, example snapshots, Bootstrap Metadata checksums, and focused generator tests together.
